metric_definitions.thesis_strict: Accepted repeat captures only; position selected by require_robot_frame_tip; per-target centroid is mean XYZ; RMSE/max are 3D Euclidean distances to centroid.
metric_definitions.legacy_style: Legacy comparison of desired-target/repeat captures only. The original script used T_tip_2_model XYZ positions, filtered abs(x)<100 mm, used mean XYZ centroids, computed 3D Euclidean RMSE/max, and plotted XY clusters.

legacy_style_comparison.definition: Desired-target/repeat captures only; mean XYZ centroid per target; XY_RMSE is XY-plane distance to centroid; XYZ_RMSE and max_deviation are 3D Euclidean distances to centroid. Legacy figure labels used XYZ_RMSE while plotting XY.
